## Claim amendment: item 1, round 2. The merge queue dequeued PR objectui#12203 on a readiness wait this change emptied · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T08:28Z

This amends claim `6119197321`, item 1 only. Items 2 and 3 are unchanged and still wait.

**What happened.** The merge-queue build of PR objectui#12203 (run `38221824123`, base `9646e2e`) failed `Test (shard 2/8)` on one test. That test is `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx`, case "the standalone developer/api-console route honours the preset": `findByPlaceholderText('/api/v1/...')` timed out, and the DOM printed is the new `LoadingScreen` with its line EMPTY. The PR's own run on `0366b47` passed the same test. The queue dequeued the PR with `CI_FAILURE`.

**Why it is this PR's failure, not a flake.**
- That file's readiness wait, `lazyRouteSettled()`, was added for objectui#10645, when a cold lazy route missed the 1000 ms `findBy*` default on a loaded shard.
- It waits until no text in `LAZY_ROUTE_FRAMES = [en.console.initializing, 'Loading API console…']` is on screen.
- After this change, the splash draws no line while the active pack is not resident, which is the case in this harness. So the wait passes at once while the splash is still up, and the `findBy*` after it is back to racing the module loader on 1000 ms.
- The PR did not change the test, but it made the test's wait vacuous. It passed on the PR's run because the route resolved in time; under the queue's load it did not.

**The same root cause as objectstack-ai/objectstack#22992.** Both suites detect the boot splash by its English text, and this change makes that text language-dependent and sometimes absent. The text cannot be the marker.

**Amended file surface, added to item 1:**
- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx`: the splash's root carries one language-independent marker, present in every state of the splash (loading, `message`, error). It is a DOM attribute only: ⛔ no new export, prop or type.
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx`: `lazyRouteSettled()` waits until the marker is gone, and keeps its `'Loading API console…'` frame for the page's own loader. It no longer keys on `console.initializing`'s text.
- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.bootCopy-12187.test.tsx`: a pin that the marker is on the splash in each state, and absent once the splash is gone.
- The changeset gains one sentence naming the marker as the splash's language-independent hook.

**Measured before this amendment:** `git grep` at `0366b47` finds no other test or e2e that detects the splash by its text. The other hits are copy pins, `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` (a comment) and `examples/console-starter/README.md` (prose).

`Clause-②: yes` stands. The contract review PASS `6120238134` was on `0366b47`, and a new head needs a new review before the queue.
